blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — An effusive US President Donald Trump has lavished praise on the leaders of Australia, India and Japan as he announced new partnerships to boost maritime security and artificial intelligence adoption. At his first Quad meeting since his re-election in 2024, Mr Trump said it was an honour to meet with his “friends”, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Japanese leader Sanae Takaichi and Anthony Albanese, on the sidelines of the Asean summit in Manila. “These nations represent some of the most important partnerships in the entire world,” he said on Tuesday night, before media was ushered away and the […]...
